verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only release management: sentry-cli can create, edit and delete releases and upload artifacts, and the releases docs page is titled only 'Associate Commits'. That is adjacent bookkeeping, not release health monitoring. No item mentions crash-free sessions or users, adoption per release, or comparing a canary release against a stable one.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can watch release health — crash-free sessions and users, adoption per release — and compare a canary release against the last stable one
